decisions.decision: Host the library on the public competency site
decisions.why: Maintainer choice 2026-10-06; existing search, no new service, readable without log-in

decisions.decision: One resources.yaml at the repo root; descriptor resources: lists move into it
decisions.why: A resource serves several competencies; one copy avoids drift

decisions.decision: Built-in MkDocs search over one library page with a heading per resource
decisions.why: Indexes each heading; nothing new to run
decisions.rejected: A custom JS filter or separate index

decisions.decision: Stdlib link checker in a weekly workflow that keeps one issue open
decisions.why: No new dependency; weekly meets SC-004

decisions.decision: Library link via custommenuitems (browser and app), verified in 5.2 source first
decisions.rejected: block_ltuse onward route, kept as the fallback

decisions.decision: Shared scripts/library.py for validate and render
decisions.why: gen_site.py runs only inside mkdocs, so its logic could not be tested; the check and the build need the same rules
decisions.rejected: Duplicating the rules in the check and gen_site.py

decisions.why: Cloudflare-style bot screens would report the same live pages every week

decisions.decision: Kept original urls even where they redirect
decisions.why: Redirects still resolve; changing them is a content call for the maintainer
decisions.rejected: Rewriting 14 urls to their redirect targets
